children: Major Gulf stock markets edged higher in early Monday trading, though investor sentiment remained cautious following a weekend of maritime strikes between the U.S. and Iran.
The escalation intensified on Saturday when U.S. Central Command struck three Iranian oil tankers, including one near Iran's vital Kharg Island export terminal.

In response, Iran's Revolutionary Guard Navy announced it had targeted three tankers navigating unauthorized routes in the Strait of Hormuz, as well as three additional U.S. vessels in neighboring waters.
